simple.meaning: עַי (ʻAy) appears 40 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Joshua, Ezra, Nehemiah, Isaiah, and 1 more, beginning at Genesis 12:8. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as altar, kingship, city, land, mountain.

simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows עַי through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
